method: Actual dependencies route body including DTO/JSON serialization, SQLite, 100k shared fixture findings and 100k components; tracemalloc enabled; no middleware/network/authentication. Cold rebuild measured separately from fresh-session warm requests.

evidence_sql:
SELECT finding_observations.id, finding_observations.finding_id, finding_observations.execution_id, finding_observations.image, finding_observations.image_digest, finding_observations.package, finding_observations.installed_version, finding_observations.fixed_version, finding_observations.evidence, finding_observations.simplified_key, finding_observations.simplified_package, finding_observations.simplified_remediation, finding_observations.simplified_fixed, finding_observations.simplified_package_sort, finding_observations.simplified_fixed_sort, finding_observations.search_folded 
FROM finding_observations 
WHERE finding_observations.execution_id = ? ORDER BY finding_observations.id

SELECT executions.raw_payload AS executions_raw_payload 
FROM executions 
WHERE executions.id = ?

SELECT JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_QUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(executions.raw_payload, ?)), ?)) AS anon_1 
FROM executions 
WHERE executions.service_id = ? ORDER BY executions.scanned_at DESC, executions.id DESC
